what: A white curtain shows a center image (a cat) and a blinking Loading... that turn on at .3s. At 2s an accent-color circle spreads from the center to the screen edges over 1.4s to become the logo panel, and at 2.8s a hole in the middle of that panel grows linearly over .6s (radial mask 0 → 100%) so the page is revealed in a circle. Scrolling is locked meanwhile, and the same visitor does not see it again within the once time.

options.hold: When the circle starts to spread (sec), default 2
options.hole-at: Time when the hole begins to open (s), default 2.8 — scroll is released and fx:open fires
options.hole: Time (sec) for the hole to open fully, default .6
options.end: When to remove the curtain (sec), default 5 — fx:done
options.once: If the visitor returns within this time (hours), the veil lifts in .3s and ends, default 0 (always plays) — original 8
options.[data-fx-part=label]: ‹Loading...› text beside the image (.7s blink, optional)

note: For screens opened often like an app, shorten hold, hole-at and end (e.g. hold: .6; hole-at: 1; /  end: 1.8). Image size · logo shape — once the using side’s css hole starts to open (hole-at), it doesn’t intercept input (pointer-events: none) — the original intercepted until it cleared at 5 seconds
